title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache + parallelism
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: Our monolithic .github/workflows/ci.yaml has grown large and slow to iterate on. It runs lint, unit tests, integration tests, and release automation in a single mega-job which increases queue time, reduces cache locality, and makes failures noisy. This PR splits the monolith into three focused workflows (lint, test, release), tightens cache keys to increase hit rate across matrices, and enables parallelism for test shards to reduce overall CI time.

What I changed: - Added .github/workflows/lint.yml (fast, cacheable, runs on PRs and pushes to branches) - Added .github/workflows/test.yml (unit + integration matrix, test sharding via buildkite/gha parallelism) - Added .github/workflows/release.yml (publish automation separated, uses dedicated token scope) - Reworked cache keys to include OS, node-version, yarn-lock checksum, and workspace fingerprint - Consolidated and upgraded actions to latest stable (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, pnpm/action-setup@v3) - Introduced test sharding script and matrix generator for slow suites - Removed legacy steps from ci.yaml and kept a lightweight smoke-check workflow for cross-repo quick checks

Checklist: - [x] Split workflows and validated locally with act where possible - [x] Confirmed cache keys produce cache hits on repeat runs - [x] Verified lint workflow completes < 2m on changed packages - [x] Verified test workflow parallel shards reduce wall time by ~40% on 200-file change set - [x] Coordinated with infra to ensure runner concurrency limits are respected

Notes on rollout: This is a non-breaking CI hygiene change. Release workflow uses a new secret (RELEASE_GHA_TOKEN) scoped to repo:packages and has been provisioned. We'll monitor the first 48h of merges for cache misses and flaky tests.

Related: ENG-4213 (CI hygiene), ENG-3987 (reduce PR queue time).
commits_summary: 7 commits: initial split of workflows; add lint.yml; add test.yml with matrix and sharding; add release.yml and token handling; bump actions versions; refine cache key hashing; fix test shard ordering flakiness
review_comments: Riley Chen: Left a few suggestions around cache key entropy - include pnpm-lock.yaml checksum to avoid invalidation on unrelated changes.
Ava Martinez: Thanks! Updated cache helper to incorporate pnpm-lock checksum and workspace fingerprints (see commit).
Morgan Patel: Can we limit test parallelism to runner capacity? We hit quota on the org during a larger PR last week.
Ava Martinez: Added concurrency group and honor GHA runner limits; also added protective gating in test.yml to cap concurrency to 8 by default.
Jordan Lee: Approving, left minor comment about release token scope (make sure it's repo-scoped, not org).
Infra-bot: Notified about new secret RELEASE_GHA_TOKEN - secret exists in repo.
release_notes: Split CI workflows for faster iteration: lint, test, and release are now separate workflows. Improved cache keys and enabled test sharding to reduce CI wall time. Upgraded major GHA actions to v4 where applicable.
notes: First-party rollout observed ~38% median reduction in CI runtime on sample PRs. Monitor for cache miss regressions and flaky integration tests in the next 7 days.
